# Send a daily Trello board digest to Discord

**Pattern:** Schedule → read → summarise → notify · **Level:** Production · **Trigger:** Schedule (daily)

## What it does
Reads the cards on a Trello list once a morning and posts a grouped, counted digest to Discord — an async standup that's ready before anyone logs on.

## Why it exists
Live standups are expensive and board-checking is tedious. A daily digest gives the whole team the state of the board in one message, with overdue and due-today work surfaced.

## Main flow
Every Morning 09:00 → Get Cards on List → Build Digest → Format Message → Post Digest to Discord (failure → error rail).

## Use it for
- A distributed team dropping the live standup
- A morning 'state of the sprint' post
- Daily client-channel updates with no manual work

## You get
- A standup that writes itself
- Overdue/due-today called out up top
- One scheduled message vs everyone checking the board

## Before first run
Connect credentials: Trello API; Discord webhook URL.
Colour key: 🟦 entry · 🟫 app I/O · ⬜ logic · 🟩 output · 🟥 error rail.
Each node has its own doc card underneath — read those before editing.

## Try it now
This runs on a timer; the Trello read is pinned so you can preview the digest before connecting anything. Sample data is pinned on the trigger, so hit **Execute Workflow** to watch it flow end to end before attaching a single credential. Right-click → Unpin when you go live.

## Credentials setup

Credentials are never bundled in a template. Every node that talks to an external service needs its own connection before the first real run — open the node, click the Credential dropdown, choose **Create new**.

**Trello API**
Trello → click your avatar → Power-Ups admin → API key; then authorize a token from the same page. n8n's Trello credential takes the API key + token.
_Gotcha:_ The token must belong to an account that is a member of the board, or every call 401s.

**Discord webhook URL**
Server Settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New Webhook → Copy Webhook URL. Paste it into n8n's Discord Webhook credential.
_Gotcha:_ A webhook URL is bound to one channel. Use a separate webhook/credential per channel you post to.

Set each credential up once; it is reusable across every workflow in your instance.

## Troubleshooting

**Nothing happens when the event should fire**
Cause: The workflow is still a draft, or its trigger is inactive.
Fix: Publish/activate it. The manual test URL is different from the production URL.

**A node shows a red triangle right after import**
Cause: No credential is attached yet.
Fix: Expected on a fresh import — open the node and attach a credential (see the Credentials note).

**The digest is empty**
Cause: The list ID is wrong, or the list genuinely has no cards.
Fix: Confirm TRELLO_LIST_ID points at the list you mean — it's the list, not the board, ID.

**The message is cut off in Discord**
Cause: Discord hard-caps a message at 2000 characters.
Fix: Split long boards into multiple posts, or send only overdue + due-today (see Practice).

**Provider returns 429**
Cause: You are hitting the API rate limit.
Fix: The node already retries with backoff; widen the schedule interval or lower the batch size to stay under quota.

Still stuck? The **Executions** tab shows the exact node that failed and the data going into it — start there.

## Design decisions

Aggregation happens in a single Code node so 'what counts as overdue' is one obvious place to edit, not logic smeared across IF/Filter nodes. Overdue and due-today lines are conditional in the Set expression so a clean board produces a clean message instead of empty headers. The read is on a list, not the whole board, because a digest of every card on every list is noise, not a standup.

## Practice exercises

Already production-shaped — deepen it:

1. Read two lists (e.g. 'In Progress' and 'Blocked') and label each section.
2. Post only when there are overdue cards, to make the message signal-only.
3. Split boards over 2000 chars into a thread of messages.

## 🛠 Customize me

Change the 09:00 cadence on the schedule and the list on **Get Cards on List** (`TRELLO_LIST_ID`). Edit **Build Digest** to change grouping or the overdue window, and **Format Digest Message** for layout. To digest several lists, add more Get-Cards nodes and merge before Build Digest.

## 🔐 Security

A read-only Trello token is enough here. The digest exposes every card name on the list to the channel — point it at a private team channel. No PII beyond card content leaves n8n; the Discord webhook URL stays in the credential.
